# Test fixtures

- `description_heatpump.json`: `GetGuiDescriptionForGateway` response of a Wolf CHA heat pump with BM-2, MM1 and ISM. Source: `parameters-examples/heatpumpparameter.json` of [wolf-comm](https://github.com/janrothkegel/wolf-comm) (Apache-2.0, Copyright Jan Rothkegel and contributors), redacted with `scripts/record_fixtures.py` (serial number and manufacturing date blanked).
- `real/`: responses of the owner's installation, recorded and redacted with `scripts/record_fixtures.py`. System and gateway IDs are replaced by 1234 and 5678.
- `real/write_response_<n>.json`: the body the portal returned for one `WriteParameterValues` call, taken from the `response` field of the write history. Record it after an approved real write: Settings › Devices & services › Wolf SmartSet › Download diagnostics, copy `writes.history[-1].response` into the file, run `scripts/check-fixtures.sh`. Identifiers are already redacted by the integration (`write.redact_ids`). No such file exists yet; interpreting the body is a separate decision (`docs/reviews/2026-10-25-write-pipeline.md`, decision 2).
